generation_preserved.prompt_exact: Create one independent BARE WOOD SCAFFOLD layer for an Engelmann oak (Quercus engelmannii) for a Southern California inland foothill yard. The supplied sycamore is ONLY a project-generated pixel-art STYLE/LIGHT reference, NOT a species photograph and NOT the desired trunk or leaf shape. Design ORIGINAL oak anatomy: a sturdy moderately short thick light gray-brown furrowed oak trunk, low broad forks, rounded spreading irregular bough architecture, fine tapered twig tips, a quiet natural root flare with only a few tiny contact stones. This wood is an authoring layer to be covered by evergreen/semi-deciduous Engelmann oak foliage; do not imply every tree becomes bare in ordinary winter. No needles, no leaves, no acorns. Not mottled cream sycamore bark, not a twisted bonsai pine, not a symmetrical tree icon or face in the bark. Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with deliberate small crisp square clusters, stepped contours, intricate restrained bark planes and warm upper-left light matching the reference quality. Side/three-quarter garden view with slight top visibility, calm organic silhouette. Square production canvas. Entire tree completely inside a broad empty real-alpha border: visible branch silhouette only from x0.10 to0.90, y0.10 to0.72; root contact centered x0.52 y0.90; no part touches the image edges. Show all branch tips and roots fully. No foliage, birds, text, UI, frame, backdrop, checkerboard, ground rectangle, lawn patch or large baked cast shadow. Real alpha outside wood and through every gap. This is separate original wood only, not a whole flattened tree.

generation_preserved.prompt_exact: Create ONLY a separate HEALTHY LEAF-ON CANOPY layer for an Engelmann oak (Quercus engelmannii), registered to bare wood scaffold image1. Image2 is our generated leaf/acorn morphology candidate: use its small blue-gray-green leathery oblong smooth/slightly wavy leaf silhouette; no deep lobes, maple stars, holly spines or pine needles. This is a normal healthy leaf-on appearance of a semi-/drought-deciduous species; do NOT assert permanent universal evergreen behavior. Independent canopy only: no tree trunk, large woody limbs, roots, stones, acorns, ground or cast shadow. Real transparent alpha everywhere outside leaves and through airy irregular gaps. Preserve the square coordinate system of image1. Place a broad rounded asymmetrical oak crown around its bough tips: main upper crown near x0.43 y0.17, left mass near x0.20 y0.42, right mass near x0.76 y0.43, a few lower outer clusters down to y0.67. Keep lower central trunk space below y0.64 transparent. Complete foliage must fit inside x0.06 to0.94 and y0.08 to0.72 with generous transparent margin, no crop along any edge. Richly detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with crisp small square clusters and stepped outlines, warm upper-left light, muted dusty blue-gray-green and olive foliage, restrained pale green highlights, quiet shadow depth. Rounded clumps must consist of MANY SMALL OBLIQUE/OBLONG leathery leaves with fine deliberate pixel veins at the edge, not overlarge tropical leaves. Maintain an open readable crown with gaps for the underlying oak branches, not one solid circular shrub, and not separate unregistered decorative plant icons. Original production art matching image1 style and scale. No birds, text, border, UI, background, checkerboard, unrelated plants or orange autumn. Only one canopy RGBA overlay, suitable for later compositing over the supplied wood.
